boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 林業試驗所蓮華池研究中心（日月潭國家風景區官方列名）的天然闊葉林與池塘景觀（OSM pond 節點）；清單主題的螢火蟲/油桐花季窗查無本站可繫結的權威季節資料源，誠實不建時間窗契約——本契約為森林池塘主體；與既有 tw-020 金龍山（3.45km）題材錯位——金龍山為日出雲海展望平台。
boosters_i18n.en: Forest-and-pond landscape inside the Taiwan Forestry Research Institute's Lianhuachi Research Center (listed by the Sun-Moon Lake NSA official site; OSM pond node). The list's firefly/tung-blossom windows have no authoritative seasonal source we can bind, so no time-window contract is built - honestly. Disjoint from tw-020 Jinlongshan's sunrise/cloud-sea lookout 3.45 km away.
boosters_i18n.ja: 林業試驗所蓮華池研究中心（日月潭国家風景区公式掲載）の林と池（OSM）。蛍・油桐の季節窓は権威源がなく誠実に不構築。金龍山とは題材が別。

penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。
